install_cmds: python -c "import torch, numpy, PIL; print('image-matting deps: torch', torch.__version__, 'numpy', numpy.__version__)"

data_deps.name: image_matting_composition1k
data_deps.description: Licensed Adobe Composition-1K full protocol staged offline before image construction: all 43,100 canonical training composites and all 1,000 canonical test composites, with train foreground/background/alpha layers and test alpha mattes. Training uses 320x320 crops for 100,000 optimizer steps; one trained model is evaluated on every test composite under trimap widths 6, 9, and 12. The final verifier performs no download, extraction, conversion, dependency installation, or data preparation.
